# Story 3: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash: Asymmetric Compute MoE Architecture
### Paper
[confident] DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is a 552-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts preprint, and it's the top story on Hacker News right now — 650 points, 380 comments, six outlets confirming.

### Architecture
[amazed] The twist is asymmetric compute: experts get uneven budgets, so cheap tokens route through tiny experts while hard tokens get the heavy ones. That's how you get MoE efficiency without losing reasoning depth.

### Release Horizon
[curious] Weights are already on Hugging Face alongside PyTorch checkpoints and a full benchmark table. Fair warning — it's a preprint, so benchmark independently before you rebuild your stack around it.
